headlines.title: ‘7080은 불안 감·2030은 박탈감 ’…‘ 폭발 직전 ’ 부동산 민심
headlines.summary: ■ 커뮤니티 게시물 1365건 분석 세제개편 부정적 반응 77.4% 7080, 늘어날 세금 납부 걱정 2030, 외곽으로 밀려나 불만 연합뉴스 정부의 부동산 세제개편안 발표를 앞두고 국내 온라인 커뮤니티에서 잦은 부동산정책 변화에 대한 불만과 우려의 목소리가 폭발하고 있다.

headlines.title: 2.5억 전세대출, 月이자 125만원 ‘ 껑충 ’
headlines.summary: 전세자금 대출 금리도 6% 돌파 은행채·코픽스 금리 상승 영향 고정형 주담대 금리도 8% 눈앞 한은 긴축에 금리 상승세 장기화 지난달 은행들이 주택담보대출 조이기에 나선 가운데 전세자금 대출 금리도 가파르게 상승, 연 6%를 돌파하고 있다. 사진은 2일 서울 시내 주요 은행 ATM기기 모습.

headlines.title: “ 은행돈도 당첨돼야 받나 ” 잔금대출 한도 완화에 ‘ 역차별 ’ 불만
headlines.summary: 주택 매수 실수요자 ‘대출 절벽’ 여전 “상환 능력에 맞는 대출 열어달라” 전문가 ‘수평적 형평성’ 필요 지적 은행권이 잔금대출을 앞둔 실수요자의 어려움을 해소해 달라는 금융당국의 요청에 대출 문을 잇따라 열어주면서 시장의 반응이 엇갈리고 있다.

headlines.title: 엔화 무너지자 美日 '공동 방어'…"추가 개입 도 불사"

headlines.title: 미·일 기습 ‘ 환율공조 ’에 시장 출렁 … 엔캐리 청산 공포 이어지나

headlines.title: 국내 주식형 ETF 내던진 개미들

headlines.title: 서학개미 역대급 순매수 … 해외투자 심리 더 강해졌다

기타.summary: 전력·인프라 비용 급등에 부담 건설 계획하던 AI기업들 부상미국 주정부들이 인공지능(AI) 데이터센터 유치를 위해 제공해온 대규모 세금 감면 혜택을 잇달아 축소하거나 폐지하는 움직..

top5_headlines.title: 5개국 순방 마친 李대통령, 주식· 부동산 국내 현안에 집중
top5_headlines.summary: 연합뉴스 미국과 남미 3개국, 독일로 이어지는 5개국 7박 11일 순방 일정을 마무리하고 3일 귀국한 이재명 대통령이 주식시장 및 부동산 정책 등 국내 시급한 현안을 검토할 것으로 보인다.

top5_headlines.title: 국내 주식형 ETF 내던진 개미들
top5_headlines.summary: 코스피 17% 폭등에도 대거 순매도 신뢰잃은 개인, 美증시 ETF로 이동 코스피 하락 출발, 삼전닉스 7%대↓ “본전 찾고 떠난다”, “원금만 회복하면 손절하고 국장은 다시 쳐다 보지도 않겠다” 국내 한 증권사 모바일트레이딩시스템(MTS) 투자자 커뮤니티에 다수 올라온 글이다. 국내 종목에 대거 투자했던 개인투자자들의 투자심리가 빠르게 식고 있다.

top5_headlines.title: ‘7080은 불안 감·2030은 박탈감 ’…‘ 폭발 직전 ’ 부동산 민심
top5_headlines.summary: ■ 커뮤니티 게시물 1365건 분석 세제개편 부정적 반응 77.4% 7080, 늘어날 세금 납부 걱정 2030, 외곽으로 밀려나 불만 연합뉴스 정부의 부동산 세제개편안 발표를 앞두고 국내 온라인 커뮤니티에서 잦은 부동산정책 변화에 대한 불만과 우려의 목소리가 폭발하고 있다.

top5_headlines.title: 2.5억 전세대출, 月이자 125만원 ‘ 껑충 ’
top5_headlines.summary: 전세자금 대출 금리도 6% 돌파 은행채·코픽스 금리 상승 영향 고정형 주담대 금리도 8% 눈앞 한은 긴축에 금리 상승세 장기화 지난달 은행들이 주택담보대출 조이기에 나선 가운데 전세자금 대출 금리도 가파르게 상승, 연 6%를 돌파하고 있다. 사진은 2일 서울 시내 주요 은행 ATM기기 모습.

top5_headlines.title: 미·일 기습 ‘ 환율공조 ’에 시장 출렁 … 엔캐리 청산 공포 이어지나
top5_headlines.summary: 엔화 가치 상승 글로벌 자금 유출 가능성 원·엔 동조화 강화, 원·달러 환율 하방압력 엔캐리 청산 우려에 외국인 자금 이탈 우려 원·엔 환율 변동성↑, 코스피 3% 하락출발 “엔화 방향성, 원화·국내증시 흐름 좌우 변수” 가타야마 사쓰키 일본 재무상이 3일 일본 도쿄 재무성에서 미국과 일본의 공동 외환시장 개입과 관련해 취재진의 질문에 답하고 있다(위쪽).

key_headlines.title: President Lee Returns from 5-Country Tour, Focuses on Domestic Stock and Real Estate Issues
key_headlines.summary: After completing a 7-night, 11-day tour to the US, South America, and Germany, President Lee Jae-myung returned on August 3rd to address urgent domestic issues including stock market and real estate policy concerns.

key_headlines.title: Retail Investors Dump Domestic Stock ETFs Despite 17% KOSPI Rally, Shift to US Markets
key_headlines.summary: Individual investors are losing confidence in Korean equities and selling domestic stock ETFs en masse despite the 17% KOSPI surge, with many moving to US market ETFs citing losses of trust in domestic markets.

key_headlines.title: Real Estate Public Sentiment 'On Verge of Explosion' with 77.4% Negative Response to Tax Reform
key_headlines.summary: Online community analysis reveals overwhelming negative sentiment toward the government's real estate tax reform, with elderly homeowners worried about increased taxes and younger demographics concerned about being pushed to outer areas.

key_headlines.title: Jeonse Loan Interest Rates Surpass 6%, Monthly Interest on 250 Million Won Loan Jumps to 1.25 Million Won
key_headlines.summary: Jeonse (long-term deposit) loan interest rates have risen sharply above 6% annually as banks tighten lending amid rising bank bond and COFIX rates, with mortgage rates approaching 8%.

key_headlines.title: US-Japan Surprise Currency Coordination Triggers Market Volatility, Yen Carry Unwinding Fears
key_headlines.summary: A surprise joint currency market intervention by the US and Japan to strengthen the yen sparked market concerns about yen-carry trade liquidation, leading to won-yen volatility, foreign capital outflows, and a 3% KOSPI decline at market open.

sections.Hot Economy News: President Lee Jae-myung returned from an international tour to focus on urgent domestic economic issues including volatile stock markets and troubled real estate policies. Retail investors are losing confidence in Korean equities despite significant market gains, with many shifting funds to US markets instead. The government's real estate tax reform proposal has triggered significant public backlash, with online sentiment showing 77.4% negative responses and concerns from both elderly and younger demographics. Rising interest rates on jeonse loans have placed additional financial pressure on households, with monthly payments on large deposits reaching 1.25 million won. Currency intervention between the US and Japan has added market volatility and sparked fears of yen-carry trade unwinding.
sections.Macro & Fiscal Policy: July consumer inflation rose 2.8% year-over-year, marking the first time in three months above 2%, with notable increases in oil prices (15.5%), industrial products (3.7%), and agricultural items (0.9%). Service prices climbed 2.6% compared to the previous year. The government introduced a Korean version of the Inflation Reduction Act (IRA) to be implemented next year, providing tax deductions for domestic production of semiconductors, secondary batteries, renewable energy, and AI-related products. US manufacturing activity reached a 4-year high in July with strong job growth, though inflation pressures remain concerning. Market expectations for US employment data this week focus on potential implications for future Federal Reserve rate decisions.
sections.Financial Markets: The traditional relationship between stock market declines and currency appreciation (depreciation of the won) has broken down, with both KOSPI and the won-dollar exchange rate declining simultaneously in a decoupling phenomenon. US markets rallied on August 3rd with major indices up over 1% as oil prices fell sharply, supporting both stocks and bonds amid easing geopolitical tensions. The 10-year US Treasury yield declined while the Federal Reserve's rate hike probability for September reflected market expectations for potential policy shifts. Foreign investor sentiment remains cautious with concerns about currency volatility affecting market entry decisions.
sections.Industry & Technology: The government announced tax incentives for strategic industries including semiconductors and batteries, offering tax deductions for domestic production while imposing minimum 30% surcharges on companies that artificially lower stock prices to reduce inheritance taxes. The Korean IRA framework covers semiconductors, secondary batteries, solar and wind power, critical materials, AI, and robotics production incentives. China approved eight additional nuclear reactors to support power demand from AI, data centers, and electric vehicles while reducing carbon emissions. Tech giants Microsoft and Amazon reported strong cloud growth despite concerns about AI investment costs, providing some market relief.
sections.Real Estate: Real estate experts predict increased property listings before the 2028 capital gains tax deduction reduction takes effect, with particular speculation about high-value and elderly single-homeowner transactions. The government's comprehensive real estate tax reform is expected to shift housing demand toward mid-sized apartments in areas like Mapo and Seongdong, potentially worsening the jeonse crisis. Seoul apartment monthly rents have surged to an average of 1.6 million won, reaching levels not seen since the 2011 jeonse crisis, while average jeonse prices stand at 622.27 million won. The tax reform's focus on residential use is expected to reduce rental supply and exacerbate housing affordability challenges.
sections.International Economy: The US Federal Reserve is considering reducing the frequency of FOMC meetings from eight to six per year for the first time in 45 years, signaling a potential shift in policy communication strategy. The surprise joint currency intervention between the US and Japan to support the yen marked the first coordinated action in 28 years, reflecting concerns about carry trade unwinding and financial stability. Twenty-five US states have filed lawsuits challenging the Trump administration's additional tariffs on imports from 60 countries, arguing the actions violate legal procedures. The Dow Jones reached record highs while NASDAQ gained 2% as oil prices collapsed and geopolitical tensions eased, with markets now pricing in at least a 25 basis point rate cut possibility in September.
sections.AI & Economy: AI-driven data center investments are opening a new era of intelligent manufacturing, with Korea positioned as a strategic hub given its historical track record of transitioning between industrial cycles. Companies reorganizing their operations around AI have achieved double revenue growth, signaling fundamental changes in corporate success formulas. Amazon's market capitalization exceeded 3 trillion dollars as investor attention shifted from semiconductor competition to AI infrastructure and cloud platforms, with the company developing proprietary accelerators like Trainium. Memory semiconductors are evolving from cost centers to performance variables in the AI era, requiring strategic focus on reliability and speed rather than just cost reduction.
sections.Others: East Asian currencies including the won (38% undervalued) and yen (50% undervalued) remain significantly below purchasing power parity despite coordinated currency interventions. The domestic M&A market is expected to be driven by physical AI, robotics, and supporting infrastructure sectors in the second half, with companies willing to divest business units to fund strategic investments. California's proposed wealth tax on billionaires faces challenges as high-net-worth individuals relocate, threatening the state's tax base that depends heavily on top earners for 40% of income tax revenue. KG Mobility is raising investment from Chinese automaker Chery, raising concerns about potential shift toward contract manufacturing rather than independent vehicle production.
